summary.text: Heather Bauer is a Democratic state representative from Richland County who has represented South Carolina House District 75 since November 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A businesswoman and co-owner of Warrior Fitness, Bauer is first vice chair of the House Operations and Management Committee.

paragraphs.text: Bauer holds a B.S. from Indiana University of Pennsylvania and an M.A. from the University of South Carolina.
Her legislative biography lists her as co-owner of Warrior Fitness, vice president of the board of the Nickelodeon Theatre, and a board member of the City of Columbia Food Policy Committee.
Bauer took office on November 14, 2022, succeeding Kirkman Finlay III.
She also serves on the Agriculture, Natural Resources and Environmental Affairs Committee.
In the November 3 general election she faces Republican Tracy Robins and Libertarian Joshua Parks.
